_comment: Story lenses for the Capital Movement Explorer. One engine, a lens per ICP: each lens is a saved angle on the same data: a title + caption you can read on camera, plus the filters that frame it. The ICP lenses (gc, cranes, equipment, datacenter, maintenance) each speak to one buyer segment; the brand/structure lenses zoom back out. filters: null/missing = no constraint. NOTE: the 'maintenance' lens only shows data once caps.pdm > 0 in config.js and the backend pdm_cmms_facilities_public view exists (see docs/ICP_explorer.md).

lenses.title: Where capital is moving
lenses.caption: Every signal we track, on one map. The dots are real projects, opportunities, facilities, and companies. The bigger the dot, the bigger the dollars behind it.

lenses.title: Global signal expansion
lenses.caption: International permits, planning, tenders, public works, procurement, and the North America signal base in one map view.

lenses.title: EMEA tenders
lenses.caption: European, UK, Middle East, and Africa tender and procurement signals currently in the explorer.

lenses.title: LATAM public works and procurement
lenses.caption: Latin America public works, procurement, environmental, development finance, and infrastructure signals.

lenses.title: APAC development and procurement
lenses.caption: Asia-Pacific development and procurement signals as they enter the explorer coverage.

lenses.title: North America signals
lenses.caption: Existing US and Canada projects, permits, facilities, opportunities, and account signals.

lenses.title: General contractors: the build pipeline
lenses.caption: The construction and capital projects forming right now, sized by dollars. This is the pipeline a GC wants to be positioning against before the bid hits the street.

lenses.title: Cranes are going up here
lenses.caption: Scored construction projects with a predicted crane window. This is where a crane company wants to be calling right now.

lenses.title: Equipment dealers: where the orders are
lenses.caption: The largest projects and opportunities across every industrial vertical: the sites that buy or rent heavy equipment as they break ground. Sell into the build, not after it.

lenses.title: The data center gold rush
lenses.caption: Hyperscalers are spending. Each star is a data center opportunity, sized by estimated crane spend. Some single sites carry hundreds of millions in lift work.

lenses.title: Plants near a maintenance RFP
lenses.caption: Industrial facilities scored for predictive-maintenance and CMMS buying intent. Each one is a plant 30 to 270 days from an RFP, with sourced evidence behind the score. The named-account hunting list for a maintenance-software vendor.

lenses.title: Electrical contractors: the next 120 days
lenses.caption: Projects whose live signals say electrical scope is coming -- permits, interconnects, RFPs -- with an estimated window for when the work opens. Call the GC before the bid hits the street.

lenses.title: Steel is about to go up here
lenses.caption: Structural permits and lift activity that precede fabrication and erection orders. The window estimate is when steel hits the schedule.

lenses.title: Heavy haul: loads forming now
lenses.caption: Oversize permits, interconnect queues, and module deliveries that put heavy loads on the road months out. Longest windows in the system.

lenses.title: Temp power before the grid arrives
lenses.caption: Sites that will need generators and temporary power between groundbreaking and interconnection. Window estimated from utility and capex signals.

lenses.title: Rigging windows opening
lenses.caption: The empirical lag model: signals to crane-and-rigging need, peak around day 110. Each dot carries its window estimate.

lenses.title: Telehandlers on site soon
lenses.caption: Structural permits, hiring spikes, and pre-bid activity that put telehandlers on site. Peak need around day 319 after the signal.

lenses.title: Dirt moves first
lenses.caption: Utility, infrastructure, and capital-improvement signals that precede excavation packages. Earthmoving is the first trade on site.

lenses.title: Scaffolding & industrial services
lenses.caption: Turnaround and RFP signals that precede scaffolding, insulation, and coatings scopes -- the industrial-services window.

lenses.title: Concrete pours coming
lenses.caption: Structural and zoning signals roughly four weeks ahead of pour schedules. Shortest lag in the model.

lenses.title: Equipment buyers in motion
lenses.caption: Rental contracts, RFPs, and permits that flag equipment acquisition ahead. The dealer and rental hunting list.

lenses.title: Crane companies: every window in the system
lenses.caption: The core motion at full width -- 6,100+ projects with crane-relevant signals and a window opening inside 120 days, across 38 states.

lenses.title: Equipment financing: capex about to be spent
lenses.caption: SEC capex filings, funding events, and permits that precede equipment purchases -- the moment financing gets shopped.

lenses.title: Crane dealers: where fleets will grow
lenses.caption: Permit and lift activity dense enough to drive crane purchases and rentals. The dealer's territory map.

lenses.title: DC hardware: racks follow the cranes
lenses.caption: Interconnects, site plans, and fab orders that put hardware deliveries 12 weeks out. 5,100+ windows opening.

lenses.title: Mechanical & HVAC scope forming
lenses.caption: Structural permits plus utility signals that flag mechanical packages ahead -- 4,900+ windows in the next 120 days.

lenses.title: Solar & battery EPC: the queue is the pipeline
lenses.caption: Interconnection queues and utility filings 12 weeks ahead of EPC awards, across 37 states.

lenses.title: Modular builds: longest lead, earliest call
lenses.caption: 14-week lag from signal to order -- the longest planning window in the catalog, 5,700+ open.

lenses.title: Site selectors: where capital is shopping
lenses.caption: Utility, capex, and funding signals that reveal corporate site searches before announcements.

lenses.title: Fiber follows the grid
lenses.caption: Utility and interconnect activity that precedes fiber and telecom buildouts -- 5,000 windows opening.

lenses.title: Companies in motion right now
lenses.caption: Hot prospects flagged by live triggers: hiring, leadership changes, awards, permits. Each one has a story attached. Hover to read it.

lenses.title: The billion-dollar board
lenses.caption: Filtered to projects and opportunities with the largest estimated value. When this much capital concentrates, the supply chain underneath it moves for years.

lenses.title: How it all connects
lenses.caption: Same data, as a network. Companies, projects, signals, facilities, territories, and verticals, linked. This is the engine behind every ICP lens.

lenses.title: From signal to conversation
lenses.caption: This is the CapexLayer thesis: capital signals become qualified opportunities become conversations. We watch the first move so you take the first call.

lenses.title: Capital intelligence, for everyone
lenses.caption: Big companies pay for this picture. You should be able to see it too. Same data, no gatekeeping. This is what the flow of capital looks like before it shows up in the news.
